sql: with o as (select lo.market_ticker t, regexp_replace(lo.strategy,'_closeout$','') s, lo.side os, lo.action oa, lo.created_at ca, f.side fs, f.price fp, f.quantity q, coalesce(f.fee,0) fee from live_orders lo join fills f on f.kalshi_order_id = lo.kalshi_order_id where lo.created_at > now() - interval '60 days' and lo.strategy like '%mmsell%'), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker t, quantity, realized_pnl, raw_json->>'market_result' mr, captured_at from positions order by market_ticker, captured_at desc), nt as (select t, count(distinct s) n from o group by t), per as (select o.t, o.s, min(o.ca) first_order, sum(case when o.oa='buy' then o.q else -o.q end) netq, round((sum((case when o.oa='buy' then 1 else -1 end) * o.q * ((case when o.os = p.mr then 100 else 0 end) - (case when o.fs = o.os then o.fp else 100 - o.fp end)))/100.0 - sum(o.fee))::numeric,4) fpnl, max(p.realized_pnl) rp, max(p.mr) mr, max(p.quantity) pq from o join p on p.t = o.t group by o.t, o.s), mt as (select t, sum(fpnl) tf, max(rp) rp from per group by t) select per.*, nt.n ntags from per join nt on nt.t = per.t join mt on mt.t = per.t where nt.n > 1 or abs(mt.tf - mt.rp) > 0.02 or per.mr is null order by per.t, per.s
